note: The non-compliance items an officer commonly records, with the area each one scores against, the evidence that proves it fixed, and the legal basis officers usually cite. Used to keep the classify and plan prompts consistent. It is a lookup, not a list of things to assume: an item only ever enters a case because it appeared in that operator's own report.

evidenceTypes.photo: A dated photo that shows the thing itself, not the area around it.
evidenceTypes.photo_series: Before and after photos of the same spot, both dated.
evidenceTypes.receipt: A dated receipt or invoice for the work, the part or the service.
evidenceTypes.record: A completed record sheet with real entries and dates.
evidenceTypes.certificate: A training or service certificate with the person's or company's name and a date.
evidenceTypes.contract: A signed contract or service agreement with dates.
evidenceTypes.document: A document from the food safety management pack.
evidenceTypes.none_possible: Nothing can be photographed. The fix is shown by the records over time.

items.label: Staff not washing hands at the right times
officerPhrases: staff did not wash hands between tasks
items.typicalFix: Brief every member of staff on when to wash hands, put the hand washing notice at the basin, and record the briefing on the training record.

items.label: Raw and ready-to-eat food not separated
officerPhrases: ready to eat food not protected
items.typicalFix: Move raw meat to the bottom shelf of each fridge, give ready-to-eat food its own covered containers, and set out the separation rule in the safe method for cross-contamination.

items.label: Chilled food not held cold enough
items.typicalFix: Repair or replace the unit, set it to run at 5 degrees C or below, and start the temperature record sheet for that named unit.
items.legalBasis: Food Safety and Hygiene (England) Regulations 2013 Schedule 4

items.label: Hot food not held hot enough
items.typicalFix: Repair or replace the hot hold unit, check it with a probe before service, and record the reading on the hot holding sheet.
items.legalBasis: Food Safety and Hygiene (England) Regulations 2013 Schedule 4

items.label: Cooked food cooled too slowly
officerPhrases: left to cool at room temperature
items.typicalFix: Set a cooling method with a time limit, portion into shallow trays, and record the cooling checks.

items.label: Reheating not checked
items.typicalFix: Probe reheated food to 75 degrees C, or 82 degrees C in Scotland, and record the reading.

items.label: No working probe thermometer, or no probe wipes
items.typicalFix: Buy a probe thermometer and probe wipes, calibrate the probe, and record the calibration.

items.label: Opened or prepared food not date labelled
items.typicalFix: Label every opened and prepared item with the date it was opened or made and the date it must be used by, and set the shelf lives in the safe method for stock.

items.label: Food defrosted unsafely
items.typicalFix: Defrost in the fridge in a covered container on the bottom shelf, and set the method out in the safe method for defrosting.

items.label: Open food left uncovered or unprotected
items.typicalFix: Cover and lid every container of open food in storage, including the bins under the prep table.

items.label: Allergen information not available or not accurate
items.typicalFix: Build the allergen matrix dish by dish from the ingredients you confirm, and put the ask-us notice where customers order.
items.legalBasis: Regulation (EU) 1169/2011 Article 44 and the Food Information Regulations 2014

items.label: Staff clothing, jewellery or sickness rules not followed
items.typicalFix: Provide clean over-clothing, set the jewellery rule, and get every member of staff to sign the fitness to work form.

items.label: Premises or equipment not clean enough
items.typicalFix: Deep clean the named surfaces and equipment, then put them on the cleaning schedule with a frequency and a name against each one.

items.label: Floor damaged, worn or not cleanable
items.typicalFix: Repair or replace the floor covering so it can be cleaned properly. This is building work, not paperwork.

items.label: Walls or ceiling damaged, or not cleanable
items.typicalFix: Make good and seal the surface so it wipes clean.

items.label: No usable hand-wash basin, or one blocked or without hot water, soap or towels
items.typicalFix: Free up the basin, restore hot and cold water, and keep soap and paper towels at it at all times.
items.hardStopIf: The report says there is no hand washing facility at all, or no water supply.

items.label: Evidence of pests
items.typicalFix: Get a pest control contractor in, proof the entry points, clean down, and keep the pest control log with every visit report.
items.hardStopIf: The report describes the infestation as active, widespread or severe.

items.label: Gaps, holes or doors that let pests in
items.typicalFix: Proof the named gaps and fit a brush strip to the back door.

items.label: Ventilation or extraction inadequate or greasy
officerPhrases: grease build up in the canopy
items.typicalFix: Have the canopy and ductwork cleaned by a contractor, keep the certificate, and put the filters on the cleaning schedule.

items.label: Lighting inadequate or unshielded
items.typicalFix: Replace the failed tubes and fit diffusers over lights above open food.

items.label: Equipment or work surfaces damaged, rusty or not cleanable
items.typicalFix: Replace the named items. Scored boards and rusted shelving cannot be cleaned properly.

items.label: Waste storage or refuse area unsatisfactory
items.typicalFix: Fit lids, arrange a collection frequency that keeps the yard clear, and put the yard on the cleaning schedule.

items.label: Water supply, drainage or hot water inadequate
items.typicalFix: Get a plumber to restore the supply or drainage. Nothing else can be done until this works.
items.hardStopIf: The report says there is no hot water, no drinking water supply or a failed drain.

items.label: No separate sink for food or for equipment washing
officerPhrases: no separate facilities for washing food
items.typicalFix: Install or designate a separate sink, or set out a written method for using the one sink safely and get it agreed.

items.label: Staff facilities, changing or toilet arrangements unsatisfactory
items.typicalFix: Give staff somewhere to put their coats and bags away from food, and fit a self-closing door where the toilet opens onto the kitchen.

items.label: No documented food safety management system
items.typicalFix: Put a documented system in place covering the hazards in this kitchen, in the Safer Food Better Business structure, and start using it daily.

items.label: A system exists but the records are not being filled in
items.typicalFix: Fill in the opening and closing checks every day from today, and keep the completed sheets in date order for the officer to see.

items.label: The system is a blank or generic pack that does not match this kitchen
items.typicalFix: Rewrite the safe methods around this kitchen's own equipment and dishes, by name.

items.label: No temperature records for fridges, freezers or hot holding
items.typicalFix: Start a record sheet for each named unit and record it at the times you set out in the system.

items.label: No cleaning schedule, or one that nobody follows
items.typicalFix: Write the cleaning schedule area by area and item by item, with a frequency, the product used and who does it.

items.label: Staff not trained, instructed or supervised
items.typicalFix: Get every food handler through Level 2 food safety, keep the certificates, and record the in-house briefings on the training record.

items.label: Nobody named as responsible for food safety
items.typicalFix: Name the person in charge of food safety in the system, and record what training they hold.

items.label: No supplier list or traceability records
items.typicalFix: List your suppliers with what you buy from each, and keep delivery notes and invoices in date order.

items.label: No pest control contract or log
items.typicalFix: Put a contract in place and keep every visit report in the pest control log.

items.label: The system has never been reviewed
items.typicalFix: Do the 4-weekly review, write down what changed, and sign it.

items.label: Same problems found at more than one visit
items.typicalFix: Fix the repeat item first, show the record that keeps it fixed, and say in the right to reply what has changed so it does not come back.

hardStopSignals.reason: A prohibition or closure is on the report.
Food has been identified as unsafe, detained or seized.
The report describes an active or widespread pest infestation.
Water supply, drainage or hand washing has failed.
